question: How do you implement RAG and vector search?
answer: We build production RAG implementations using Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or Qdrant — chosen based on your scale and budget. Document chunking, embedding generation, hybrid search, reranking, and cost engineering are all handled with eval-driven iteration so retrieval quality keeps improving.

question: What AI and automation services do you offer?
answer: We integrate LLMs and AI agents into SaaS products, build production RAG implementations, implement workflow automation, and develop multi-agent systems. Every AI feature ships with proper guardrails, eval pipelines, and cost engineering for production scale.

question: Why Next.js and TypeScript for SaaS?
answer: Next.js with TypeScript gives the strongest combination of performance, type safety, and developer velocity for production SaaS. Server-side rendering, edge deployment, and end-to-end type checking mean fewer production bugs and faster feature shipping.

question: How do you handle multi-tenant SaaS architecture?
answer: We design tenancy architectures matched to your customer profile and operational tolerance — single-tenant, pooled, or hybrid models. Data isolation, role-based access control, organisation hierarchies, and SSO via SAML and OIDC are all considered from day one.

question: Can you integrate with payment processors and external APIs?
answer: Yes. We build production-grade Stripe integrations including subscriptions, usage-based billing, customer portals, and dunning recovery. We also integrate with any third-party API your SaaS depends on, with proper webhook handling, retry queues, and error monitoring.
